name: write-goal
description: Help users turn a rough intention into a well-specified goal — a completion contract with a clear finish line, proof, boundaries, and stop rule.

interface.shortDescription: Craft a well-specified goal for goal mode
interface.longDescription: Use Write Goal to turn a rough intention into a completion contract for goal mode: a clear finish line, concrete proof, work boundaries, and a stop-and-report rule. It drafts the objective together with the user and starts it only after the wording is approved.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn this intention into a well-specified goal with $write-goal.
